applies_to: Shinko AER-102-ECH electrical conductivity controller with the C5 RS-485 option; manual No. AER11CECE5.
summary: The AER-102-ECH measures electrical conductivity (or salinity/TDS) and temperature, and drives up to four event outputs and two transmission outputs. With the C5 option it speaks Shinko protocol or Modbus ASCII/RTU; every item is a signed 16-bit holding register. The map covers sensor and range setup, EVT1-EVT4 settings, temperature compensation, transmission outputs, calibration modes, user save area and the measured conductivity, temperature and status words.

addressing.note: Registers are listed as hex data items (0001H) that go into the request unchanged. The manual adds that the matching Modicon holding-register number is the item in decimal plus 40001 (0001H = 40002). The manual's RTU example reads conductivity with data item 0080H (CRC 85E2H checked).

source.title: Communication Instruction Manual AER-102-ECH (C5)
source.pages: Command table pp. 11-21; communication settings p. 3

notes: Function 03 reads and 06 writes; the manual's function column shows no multi-register write (10H).
All data are 16-bit two's complement and are sent without the decimal point.
Measurement range codes (0004H) are not listed: the list changes with sensor cell constant and unit.
The status bit values in 0081H bits 12-13 and 0091H bits 4-7/12-13 are two-bit fields; only the codes listed in the manual are shown as single bits.
EVT3/EVT4 and transmission output 2 items need their options; without them writes return exception 3 (some transmission output 2 items return exception 17).

integration.summary: Select MODBUS RTU in the Basic Function Group and give the unit a non-zero instrument number; then read conductivity 0080H, temperature 0090H and the status words 0081H and 0091H.
integration.enable: Requires the C5 option. In the Basic Function Group choose Communication protocol = MODBUS RTU (or ASCII), then instrument number, speed, data bit/parity and stop bit; these are keypad-only.
quirks: Instrument number 0 is the Modbus broadcast address; give each unit 1-95.
Use Lock 3 for frequently written values so non-volatile memory is not worn out (about one million writes).
setup: Factory defaults: Shinko protocol, instrument number 0, 9600 bps, 7 bits/even parity, 1 stop bit.
For Modbus RTU choose an 8-bit data format.
Do not fit a terminator; each unit has built-in pull-up/pull-down resistors.
gotchas: Changing any EVT type resets all four EVT values to 0; write types first.
Writing transmission output 2 adjustment mode without the TA2 option returns exception 17 (11H).
